defs.def: a set of large printed sheets of paper containing news, articles, advertisements, etc. and published every day or every week 报纸；报

ex.s: I really like the idea of adding a new column to our English newspaper.
ex.t: 我真的很喜欢在我们的英文报上新增一个栏目的想法。

ex.s: "It's a really great 33    for kids,“ said a neighbor in an interview with the local newspaper.
ex.t: “这对孩子们来说真是个很棒的33___，”一位邻居在接受当地报纸采访时说。

ex.s: I began collecting newspaper articles about new species, new monkey, new spider…, and on and on they appear.
ex.t: 我开始收集关于新物种、新猴子、新蜘蛛……的报纸文章，它们源源不断地出现。

ex.s: What was the author’s initial purpose of collecting newspaper articles?
ex.t: 作者最初收集报纸文章的目的是什么？

ex.s: I always wanted to know what my mom was reading． Hearing mom say，"I can't believe what's printed in the newspaper this morning，" made me want to grab it out of her hands and read it myself． I wanted to be like my mom and know all of the things she knew． So I carried around a book， and each night， just to be like her， I would pretend to be reading．
ex.t: 我一直想知道妈妈在读什么。听到妈妈说“真不敢相信今天早上报纸上印了什么”，我就想从她手里抢过报纸自己读。我想成为像妈妈那样的人，知道她知道的所有事情。于是我随身带着一本书，每天晚上，就为了像她一样，我还会假装在阅读。

ex.s: She couldn't wait to tear the newspaper apart．
ex.t: 她迫不及待地想把报纸撕成碎片。

ex.s: The head of the language school told the local newspaper that the school is going to send Harvold on a weekend   53    to Dublin with a friend, thanking him for his    54   .
ex.t: 这所语言学校的校长告诉当地报纸，学校将送哈沃德在周末____53____与一位朋友去都柏林，并感谢他的____54____。

ex.s: She sent the journal to a newspaper, and that year Winton was seen on the British television programme That' s Life.
ex.t: 她把日记寄给了一家报社，同年，温顿出现在了英国电视节目《这就是生活》中。

ex.s: The resulting story in the local newspaper divided the people of the town: some were in favour of the new shopping mall, and some were against it.
ex.t: 当地报纸上刊登的报道使镇上的人产生了分歧：一些人支持新建购物中心，另一些人则反对。

ex.s: On leaving high school, he joined a local Kansas newspaper as a trainee reporter.
ex.t: 高中毕业后，他加入了堪萨斯州当地的一家报社，担任实习记者。

ex.s: Even newspapers, radio and TV stations play tricks on their readers and audiences.
ex.t: 甚至报纸、广播电台和电视台也会捉弄它们的读者和观众。

ex.s: You’ll also be asked to promote the islands through newspapers, magazines and TV interviews.
ex.t: 透过报纸、杂志及电视采访,

defs.def: paper taken from old newspapers 旧报纸

ex.s: Magazines and newspapers provide adults with critical news.
ex.t: 保留有趣的杂志图片给孩子提供故事灵感。

ex.s: Being exposed to magazines and newspapers benefits you a lot.
ex.t: 杂志对许多人来说是有价值的资产，尤其是对儿童。

ex.s: Magazines and newspapers are expensive now but out of style
ex.t: 当老师建议他们的孩子阅读杂志时，家长常常感到惊讶。

ex.s: I finally quit delivering newspapers and didn’t see Mrs Stanley for several years.
ex.t: 每当有人因为关心你而问候你的近况时——而不是因为他们拿了钱才这么做——你就会发现社区的存在。
